name: Diner Veggie Omelet with Cheddar
steps: Sauté the pepper, mushrooms and onion in half the oil until soft; set aside.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and cook in the rest of the oil over medium heat.
When nearly set, add the vegetables and cheddar to one half and fold.
Slide onto a plate and serve hot.

name: Denver Scramble
steps: Dice the ham, pepper and onion.
Sauté them in oil for 4 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set.
Finish with pepper and chives.

name: Egg and Turkey Sausage Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Shape the sausage into two thin patties and brown 3 minutes a side.
Fry the eggs in the oil.
Toast the muffins.
Layer sausage, egg, cheddar and spinach in each muffin.

name: Breakfast Burrito with Black Beans
steps: Scramble the eggs in the oil.
Warm the beans and tortillas.
Fill each tortilla with eggs, beans, cheese and pico.
Roll tight and serve with sliced avocado.

name: Huevos Rancheros Bowl
steps: Warm the beans with a third of the salsa.
Fry the eggs in the oil until the whites are set.
Spoon the beans into bowls and top with eggs.
Finish with the rest of the salsa, avocado, cotija and cilantro.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Berries and Pecans
steps: Stir the vanilla and cinnamon into the yogurt.
Layer yogurt and berries in two glasses.
Top with chopped pecans.

name: Overnight Oats with Apple and Cinnamon
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia and cinnamon in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with diced apple and walnuts in the morning.

name: Blueberry Protein Pancakes
steps: Whisk the oat flour, baking powder, eggs, yogurt and vanilla into a thick batter.
Fold in the blueberries.
Cook small pancakes in a buttered pan, 2 minutes a side.
Serve warm.

name: Almond Flour Waffles with Strawberries
steps: Whisk the almond flour, baking powder, eggs, yogurt and vanilla.
Cook in a greased waffle iron until golden.
Slice the strawberries.
Serve the waffles topped with berries.

name: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Peaches
steps: Divide the cottage cheese between two bowls.
Top with sliced peach, almonds and hemp seeds.
Dust with cinnamon.

name: Sweet Potato and Sausage Breakfast Hash
steps: Dice the sweet potato small and sauté in oil for 10 minutes.
Add the sausage, pepper and onion and cook 8 minutes.
Season with paprika and salt.
Make wells, crack in the eggs and cover until set.

name: Avocado Toast with Egg
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Spread, top with egg and a pinch of pepper flakes.

name: Spinach and Feta Egg Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and oil a 6-cup muffin tin.
Chop the spinach and pepper and divide among the cups.
Pour in the beaten eggs and add the feta.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Southwest Tofu Scramble
steps: Crumble the tofu and sauté with the onion and pepper in oil.
Stir in turmeric and cumin.
Add the beans and heat through.
Serve with salsa.

name: Steel-Cut Oatmeal with Walnuts and Cinnamon Apples
steps: Simmer the oats in water with salt for 20 minutes.
Cook the diced apple with cinnamon in a splash of water until tender.
Spoon the oats into bowls and top with apples and walnuts.

name: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Cucumber Bites
steps: Slice the cucumber into thick rounds.
Spread each with cream cheese.
Top with salmon, capers and dill.

name: Turkey Bacon and Egg Cups
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Line three muffin cups with turkey bacon.
Crack an egg into each and scatter with cheddar.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes and finish with chives.

name: Chia Pudding with Raspberries
steps: Stir the chia, almond milk, vanilla and sweetener.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours, stirring once.
Top with raspberries.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Oat Bowl
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 minutes.
Stir in half the banana, mashed.
Top with sliced banana and a spoon of peanut butter each.

name: Classic Turkey Club Lettuce Wrap
steps: Lay out the lettuce leaves in overlapping pairs.
Spread with mayo and mustard.
Layer turkey, crisp bacon, tomato and avocado.
Roll up tightly and slice.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
steps: Whisk the yogurt, lemon, garlic and mustard into a quick dressing.
Toss the shredded chicken and romaine with the dressing.
Spoon onto the tortillas, add parmesan and roll.

name: Tuna Salad Melt on Rye
steps: Mix the tuna, celery, chopped pickle, yogurt and mustard.
Pile onto the bread and top with cheddar.
Broil 3 minutes until the cheese melts.

name: Grilled Chicken Avocado Sandwich
steps: Pound the chicken thin, brush with oil and grill 4 minutes a side.
Toast the bread and spread with mashed avocado and mustard.
Layer chicken, tomato and arugula.

name: Turkey Burger Lettuce Wrap
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, paprika and salt and shape three patties.
Grill or pan-sear 5 to 6 minutes a side.
Wrap each patty in lettuce with tomato, onion, pickle and mustard.

name: Philly Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve the peppers and roast them cut-side up for 10 minutes at 400°F.
Slice the steak thin and sear with the onion and mushrooms in oil.
Fill the peppers, top with Swiss and bake 8 minutes.

name: Egg Salad on Ezekiel Toast
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and chop.
Fold in the yogurt, mustard, celery and chives.
Pile onto the toast and dust with paprika.

name: Pulled Chicken BBQ Sandwich
steps: Simmer the chicken in broth-free water until cooked, then shred.
Whisk the tomato paste, vinegar, paprika, garlic and sweetener into a sauce.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and warm through.
Pile onto toasted muffins with coleslaw mix.

name: Reuben Roll-Ups
steps: Lay out the turkey slices and spread with mustard.
Add Swiss, sauerkraut and a pickle spear.
Roll tight and sear seam-side down for 2 minutes.

name: Hummus and Veggie Pita Pocket
steps: Halve the pitas and open the pockets.
Spread with hummus.
Stuff with cucumber, tomato, greens, onion and feta.

name: Buffalo Chicken Lettuce Cups
steps: Brown the chicken in oil with garlic powder.
Stir in the hot sauce.
Spoon into lettuce cups.
Top with diced celery, carrot and crumbled blue cheese.

name: Open-Faced Tuna and Tomato Melt
steps: Mix the tuna with yogurt.
Spread on the toast and top with sliced tomato and mozzarella.
Broil until bubbling and finish with basil.

name: California Turkey Wrap
steps: Spread the tortillas with mashed avocado and mustard.
Layer turkey, spinach and tomato.
Sprinkle with seeds, roll and halve.

name: Sloppy Joe Stuffed Sweet Potato
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes at 400°F until tender, about 35 minutes.
Brown the turkey with onion and pepper.
Add tomato sauce, mustard, vinegar and chili powder and simmer 10 minutes.
Split the potatoes and spoon the filling over.
